models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
technicalNotes:
When found in Audi Radio/Navigation System (RNS-E):
Perform Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  of Wheel Size (ADP 001) and Impuls (ADP 002).
When found in Audi A4 (8E) Automatic Roof:
Perform Switch Reset (ADP 001).
Manually fully open, then close top with hand crank.  Then use key in door to roll windows up and down 3 times.
